traditions.WLC: אַל יֵרַ֤ע בְּ עֵינֶ֨י ךָ֙ אֶת הַ דָּבָ֣ר הַ זֶּ֔ה
traditions.VUL: Non te frangat ista res :
traditions.KJV: Let not this thing displease thee ,

25.english_reference: for the sword devoureth one as well as another :

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי כָ זֹ֥ה וְ כָ זֶ֖ה תֹּאכַ֣ל הֶ חָ֑רֶב
traditions.VUL: várius enim evéntus est belli , nunc hunc , et nunc illum consúmit gládius :
traditions.KJV: for the sword devoureth one as well as another :

25.english_reference: make thy battle more strong against the city , and overthrow it :

traditions.WLC: הַחֲזֵ֨ק מִלְחַמְתְּ ךָ֧ אֶל הָ עִ֛יר וְ הָרְסָ֖ הּ
traditions.VUL: confórta bellatóres tuos advérsus urbem ut déstruas eam ,
traditions.KJV: make thy battle more strong against the city , and overthrow it :

traditions.WLC: וְ חַזְּקֵֽ הוּ
traditions.VUL: et exhortáre eos .
traditions.KJV: and encourage thou him .

26.english_reference: And when the wife of Uriah heard that Uriah her husband was dead ,

traditions.WLC: וַ תִּשְׁמַע֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת אֽוּרִיָּ֔ה כִּי מֵ֖ת אוּרִיָּ֣ה אִישָׁ֑ הּ
traditions.VUL: Audívit autem uxor Uríæ , quod mórtuus esset Urías vir suus ,
traditions.KJV: And when the wife of Uriah heard that Uriah her husband was dead ,

traditions.WLC: וַ תִּסְפֹּ֖ד עַל בַּעְלָֽ הּ
traditions.VUL: et planxit eum .
traditions.KJV: she mourned for her husband .

27.english_reference: And when the mourning was past ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּעֲבֹ֣ר הָ אֵ֗בֶל
traditions.VUL: Transácto autem luctu ,
traditions.KJV: And when the mourning was past ,

27.english_reference: David sent and fetched her to his house ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁלַ֨ח דָּוִ֜ד וַ יַּאַסְפָ֤ הּ אֶל בֵּית וֹ֙
traditions.VUL: misit David , et introdúxit eam in domum suam ,
traditions.KJV: David sent and fetched her to his house ,

27.english_reference: and she became his wife , and bare him a son .

traditions.WLC: וַ תְּהִי ל֣ וֹ לְ אִשָּׁ֔ה וַ תֵּ֥לֶד ל֖ וֹ בֵּ֑ן
traditions.VUL: et facta est ei uxor , peperítque ei fílium :
traditions.KJV: and she became his wife , and bare him a son .

27.english_reference: But the thing that David had done displeased the LORD .

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּ֧רַע הַ דָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֥ה דָוִ֖ד בְּ עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
traditions.VUL: et displícuit verbum hoc , quod fécerat David , coram Dómino .
traditions.KJV: But the thing that David had done displeased the LORD .
